import pathlib
r = pathlib.Path('crates/pony-agent-core/src')
tui = (r / 'bin/tui.rs').read_text()
gov = (r / 'agent/governed_executor.rs').read_text()
disp = (r / 'agent/dispatcher.rs').read_text()
pth = (r / 'agent/control_plane/path_authorization_commands.rs').read_text()
def body(src, sig):
    i = src.index(sig)
    return src[i:src.index('\n}\n', i)]
fn = body(tui, 'pub fn apply_approval_decision(')
proj = body(tui, 'pub fn permission_request_from_pending(')
assert '"approvalKind": "approval"' in disp                 # C2 明确定义的「无 path」审批形态
assert 'tool_rule_ask' in gov and 'external_requires_approval' in gov  # 两条无 path 的 ApprovalRequired 产出面

i_auth = fn.index('authorize_path(&path, "read")')
i_appr = fn.index('approve_control_request(&request_id, version)')
assert i_auth < i_appr
assert 'return None;' in fn[fn.index('审批授权失败'):i_appr]  # 授权失败即早退，approve 永不执行
assert 'std::fs::canonicalize' in pth                        # 非存在路径必 Err(ENOENT)
